subject: RP9 Q13 graph key_point is [x,y] array not {x,y} object
body: Test gp-2044 found that retake-practice-9.json Q13 graph has a key_point stored as [10,8] (array) instead of {x:10,y:8} (object). All other 121 key_points across 24 graphs use the {x,y} object format. GI: please fix Q13 key_points to use object format for schema consistency.
